Hindutva Influencer Gets Interim Bail from Delhi Court

Swatantra Bhardwaj, identified as a Hindutva influencer, was granted three weeks of interim bail by a Delhi court. The details of the case for which bail was granted were not specified in the coverage. Following the bail decision, a statement was made contrasting the speed of Bhardwaj's bail with another individual's six-year wait for bail.
